================================================================================
T-SQL procedures parse bare parameters separately from execution options
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.p
@Id int
WITH EXECUTE AS OWNER
AS
BEGIN
    DECLARE @Rows AS TABLE (Id int PRIMARY KEY);
    BEGIN TRY
        BEGIN TRAN;
        SELECT @Id;
        COMMIT;
    END TRY
    BEGIN CATCH
        IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK;
        PRINT N'failed';
        THROW;
        RETURN -1;
    END CATCH;
END;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
T-SQL temporal tables keep period clauses outside the column list
================================================================================

CREATE TABLE [Application].[Cities] (
    [CityID] int CONSTRAINT [DF_Cities_CityID] DEFAULT (NEXT VALUE FOR [Sequences].[CityID]) NOT NULL,
    [StateProvinceID] int NOT NULL,
    [ValidFrom] datetime2(7) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ROW START NOT NULL,
    [ValidTo] datetime2(7) GENERATED ALWAYS AS ROW END NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Cities] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([CityID] ASC, [StateProvinceID] ASC),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Cities_StateProvince] FOREIGN KEY ([StateProvinceID]) REFERENCES [Dimension].[City] ([CityID]),
    PERIOD FOR SYSTEM_TIME ([ValidFrom], [ValidTo])
) WITH (SYSTEM_VERSIONING = ON (HISTORY_TABLE=[Application].[Cities_Archive], DATA_CONSISTENCY_CHECK=ON));

================================================================================
T-SQL inline table-valued functions return unparenthesized SELECT queries
================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.GenerateDateDimensionColumns(@Year int)
RETURNS TABLE
AS
RETURN SELECT CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.T WHERE Id = @Year) THEN @Year
    ELSE 0
END AS Value;

================================================================================
T-SQL inline table-valued functions return parenthesized SELECT queries
================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION [Application].DetermineCustomerAccess(@CityID int)
RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
RETURN (
    SELECT 1 AS AccessResult
    FROM dbo.T
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM dbo.T AS Allowed
        WHERE Allowed.Id = dbo.T.Id AND dbo.T.Id = @CityID
    )
);
